- Leaf is curled/twisted upward
- No black sooty coating (rules out Sooty_Mould)
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery_Mildew)
- No distinct spots or lesions (less consistent with Anthracnose)
- The curling upward and complete browning/withering matches Die_Back symptoms ("leaves curl upwards and fall off")
